description: Cases for assertCovers and assertPrefixesCover. Create an empty file provider/<name>.json for every entry of `names` (content does not matter: only the names are looked at), then call `call` for the kind provider: `covers` with `expected` (and `prefix`, if given), or `prefixes` with `expected` as the prefixes. `message` is the message of the coverage error, word for word, or null when the call must succeed; `withoutExpectation` and `withoutFixture` are the two lists of the error.

cases.case: covers: the expectations name exactly the fixtures
covers: a fixture without an expectation, and an expectation without a fixture
cases.message:
the expectations of this test do not cover the fixtures in provider/:
  provider/order.out-of-stock.json: no expectation in this test
  provider/order.token-invalid.json: no expectation in this test
  order.cancelled: expected here, but provider/order.cancelled.json does not exist

cases.case: covers: a prefix narrows both sides
covers: with a prefix, a fixture outside it needs no expectation, and one inside does
cases.message:
the expectations of this test do not cover the fixtures in provider/order.*:
  provider/order.out-of-stock.json: no expectation in this test

cases.case: covers: with a prefix, an expectation that does not start with it is a mistake
cases.message:
the expectations of this test do not cover the fixtures in provider/order.*:
  payment.started: expected here, but it does not start with order.
  refund.created: expected here, but it does not start with order.

cases.case: covers: no fixtures and no expectations
prefixes: every fixture starts with one of them
prefixes: a fixture that no prefix covers, and a prefix without a fixture
cases.message:
the prefixes of this test do not cover the fixtures in provider/:
  provider/refund.created.json: starts with none of the prefixes
  provider/session.created.json: starts with none of the prefixes
  payment.*: listed here, but no fixture in provider/ starts with it

cases.case: prefixes: one prefix inside another is fine
prefixes: the empty prefix covers everything
prefixes: no fixtures and no prefixes
prefixes: no fixtures, so every prefix is without one
cases.message:
the prefixes of this test do not cover the fixtures in provider/:
  order.*: listed here, but no fixture in provider/ starts with it
